title: AI adoption in code reviews
context: At Witik, the 10-person delivery team (6 developers, 2 QA engineers, 1 product owner and me as Tech Lead Delivery) contributes to a B2B SaaS platform used by 20,000+ users and 100+ clients.
action: I introduced Claude Code for assisted reviews, structured prompts and automated quality checklists.
result: Three practices are now structured in the team workflow: assisted reviews, shared prompts and quality checklists. No reliable before/after figures are available to quantify their effect on lead time or defect rates.

title: Delivery management at Witik
context: The 10-person delivery team had to coordinate the technical roadmap, releases and business priorities for a platform with 100+ clients.
action: I managed the backlog and releases through Azure DevOps, coordinated business/product/QA/development, and tracked risks and priorities.
result: Delivery sustained roughly 2 production deployments per month on a platform serving 20,000+ users and 100+ clients.

title: Multi-client projects and SRM at Sofia Holding

result: The available reference describes the SRM platform’s functional scope; no verifiable public figures are available for delivery time, supplier integrations or client satisfaction.
